Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.GameModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameModel extends Object implements Serializable
Aggregate root of the game's model layer. Holds the entire mutable game state — the Board, the per-era Decks and BuildingDecks, the player list and their associations to OrderTile / OfferTile, plus the era / round counters and the active GameState — and exposes the entry points the controller uses to drive play: addPlayer(Player), handleTotemPlacement(Player, OfferTile), pickUpCard(Player, Card).

Each player action is delegated to the current GameState, which validates it and calls back into the execute* helpers here to mutate state. After every mutation the model fires a GameEvent to its registered GameObservers and snapshots itself via PersistenceManager, so the server can rebuild a live game after a crash.

Serialisation note: the observer list is transient — observers are server-side subscriptions that do not survive a restart and are re-registered by the server on load.

    • checkCanPick

      public boolean checkCanPick()
      Reports whether the current player can still make a useful pick. A row is usable when the offer tile's quota for that row is not yet exhausted and the row contains at least one card the player can take — i.e. a character card, or a building the player can afford after applying their buildingSale discount.
      Returns:
      true if at least one pick remains available

    • resetTotemToOrder

      public void resetTotemToOrder()
      Closes out the current player's card-picking turn. Releases their offer tile, places them on the first free order tile (which fixes their seat for the next round), applies the offer-tile food bonus and order-tile bonuses, lets the player's buildings react via BuildingCard.onOwnTurnEnding, and resets the row pick counters. Fires GameEvent.TOTEM_RESET and snapshots.

    • endRound

      public void endRound()
      Runs end-of-round bookkeeping: resolves the event cards on the board (including the upper row at round 10, the era-change round), slides the board down, advances the era if the upper character/event row has dropped below gameSize + 4, and bumps the round counter. Fires GameEvent.ERA_CHANGED (if applicable) and GameEvent.ROUND_ENDED, then snapshots.

    • endGameActions

      public void endGameActions()
      Final-scoring pass run by GameEnding. For each player, adds the running builderPoints bonus, the inventor-pair bonus (inventors × distinct inventions), the artist bonus (5 points per pair of artists), and lets each owned building card contribute via BuildingCard.onGameEnding. Then deletes the save file (a cleanly finished game should not be restored on the next server start) and fires GameEvent.GAME_ENDED.

    • computeRanking

      public List<RankingEntry> computeRanking()
      Computes the final ranking using the rulebook tie-break: players are ordered by victory points descending, then by food descending. Players tied at the top score and the top food count share the win (shared victory). Ranks are 1-based and shared by players with identical (points, food); the next distinct pair resumes at its positional index.

      Must be called after endGameActions() has finalised scoring (i.e. on the GameEvent.GAME_ENDED notification). Returns domain-level RankingEntry objects; mapping them to any transport/DTO form is the caller's responsibility, keeping the model independent of the network and persistence layers.

      Returns:
      the players in final ranking order, each wrapped with its rank and winner flag
